[ASSISTANT_RESPONSE]

User: Can you help me clean up / make better an email to our founder about what we should be doing for content marketing for this brand-new beauty line? I’m trying to outline a plan across blog + Instagram + TikTok + YouTube (thinking tutorials, product reviews, and some behind-the-scenes manufacturing stuff on YouTube), plus the usual influencer collabs, giveaways, and some targeted ads… but I’m not sure what to prioritize first vs what can wait.

A couple constraints that might be fighting each other: I need it to be pretty short (founder won’t read a novel) but also detailed enough that it feels like an actual roadmap, not vibes. Also it’s just me running everything, so I need a realistic cadence (what’s the minimum that still works?) and some clear KPIs/metrics so we can tell if it’s working without overcomplicating it. If you can, anchor the recommendations in credible sources (studies/industry benchmarks) — citations are important here — but keep the email itself very readable.

Maybe structure it like: what to do in the first 30/60/90 days + what success looks like + what we’re not doing yet (on purpose). And if there are tradeoffs (e.g., more TikTok vs more blog), can you frame it in a kind of “if we believe X, then we do Y” way so it’s easier to defend?

Oh and btw one more thing: can you also give me a quick subject line + a tiny follow-up note I can send a week later if they don’t respond (same casual-professional tone)?
[ASSISTANT_RESPONSE]

User: Can you help me sanity-check a couple benchmark stats before I send this email out? I’ve got lines like 2–3x engagement and 38% of beauty purchases, but I don’t want to repeat numbers that aren’t actually in the source. Please go to the original reports (not secondary blog summaries) and confirm whether those exact figures show up. I need the exact links + the exact wording/number as it appears in the report (page/table if you can). If it’s not there, tell me what *is* there that’s closest, with the right citation.

Also, I’m trying to set minimum-viable KPIs for a brand-new beauty line (it’s just me running it). Can you propose a defensible KPI set for 30/60/90 days—ranges are fine, but not hand-wavy. I’d rather not set vanity metrics that don’t map to outcomes. Include a quick rationale for each KPI and why the range makes sense for a solo operator.

Then rewrite my email draft into ~200–250 words. Tone: super casual but still credible. Structure-wise: if we believe X, then we do Y. Three core bets. And can you include a quick tradeoff take on whether we need giveaways in month 1 (I don’t want to default to it if it’s not necessary).
[ASSISTANT_RESPONSE]
